g.text: Initial HMM search on; downstream profile refinement off in all three cells
Dots are descriptive changes, not confidence intervals. Axes use different ranges, both in percentage points.
All 18 families are development-exposed; strata overlap. Empty bins and redundant all-family copies remain in the full tables.
Length/composition, Pfam annotation and reference duplication descriptors are not causal biological validation.
